scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the paper reports the results as visual distributions and qualitative trends; the main claim is the monotonic evolution and anomalous response, not a specific metric value.

hidden_assets.purpose: Definition of structural trends: fraction of cells with ζ < 1.108 non‑decreasing and strictly increasing overall, mean ζ monotonically decreasing; for memory effect, density drop/increase at tap 31 followed by reversal.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 1, Figure 4, and associated text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Trend rules encoded directly in checker logic.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These trends are the paper's core findings; no fabricated numeric gold is needed, only the structural compliance.

outputs.description: Shape factor zeta values for interior Voronoi cells at six selected tapping stages. Used to verify microstructural evolution during compaction.

Packing density evolution under two memory-effect protocols. The CSV must include tap 30 (pre-switch density) and taps 31,32,... up to at least 50, with scenario labels. Used to verify the system's density response under abrupt intensity changes.

output_contract.notes: The checker will perform structural audits: for shape_factor_cells.json it will compute summary statistics (e.g., fraction of cells with zeta below a threshold, mean zeta) and check for trends consistent with physical compaction; for memory_effect.csv it will examine the density evolution around the intensity switch (taps 30, 31, 32) to assess the memory effect. Specific trend directions are not disclosed.

steps.description: Compute fraction of Voronoi cells with ζ < 1.108 per tap; verify it is non-decreasing across taps and strictly increases from tap 2 to tap 70.
Compute mean ζ per tap; verify it monotonically decreases from tap 2 to tap 70.
For scenario 0 (3%→0.5% switch at t=30), verify density at tap 31 is less than at tap 30, and density then increases (tap 32 > tap 31).
For scenario 1 (0.5%→3% switch at t=30), verify density at tap 31 is greater than at tap 30, and density then decreases (tap 32 < tap 31).
